reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Removed the `default` section of the runtime overrides config file: This was introduced in 2.9 and likely not widely used", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Values populated in the runtime config file's `default` block are no longer honoured because the block was removed; defaults must be set in `operational_config`.
consequence.remediation: Move default values into the top-level `operational_config` in the standard Loki config.

proposed.statement: The `default` block of the runtime overrides config file (added in 2.9) was removed; set default values in the top-level `operational_config` of the standard Loki config instead.
